mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% in the month preceding the prediction triggers a forward discounting effect, lowering the present value of expected future cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not statistically different from zero during high-inflation regimes when FEDFUNDS crosses 4%, per t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a decline in UNRATE predicts increased hiring momentum that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS up while UNRATE down in the same month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, returns are flat or negative despite the labor signal, with statistical significance test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST and a simultaneous decline in INDPRO indicate strengthening demand for consumer goods relative to supply, which is associated with positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST up & INDPRO down in the same month
failure_condition: Over 100 observed instances, no significant positive returns when demand outpaces supply as measured by the proxies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in INDPRO above 105 suggests supply chain loosening, which reduces production costs and supports higher corporate valuations, yielding positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains flat or contracts for 3 consecutive quarters with no improvement in SPX 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in CPIAUCSL below 240 over the prior 2 months signals disinflation, prompting the market to anticipate lower future rate hikes and a positive 20-day S&P 500 return.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 240 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not decelerate as expected, or SPX 20-day returns remain negative.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months, reduced labor market friction lowers wage growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE remains above 4% throughout the period, or returns are not significantly negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (consumer demand) for two months predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates robust earnings.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up & HOUST up in the same month, for two consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when both proxies show strength in non-expansion regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in RSAFS below 450 suggests persistent supply constraints, which amplifies valuation sensitivity and drives negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS recovers or remains flat while SPX 20-day returns do not turn positive.
